title: ci(release): build and attach cross-platform release binaries
problem: Releases contain source only; users must build from source.
why: Prebuilt binaries dramatically lower the barrier to adoption.
scope: Add a tagged-release workflow building Linux (gnu/musl), macOS (x86_64/aarch64), and Windows binaries, with checksums.
guidance: Use `cargo build --release` per target and upload artifacts to the GitHub release.
tests: Workflow dry-run on a pre-release tag
security: Consider artifact attestation; verify checksums in docs.
dod: Merged and a release produced with binaries.

title: ci(release): publish crates to crates.io
problem: The crates are not published, so `cargo install soroban-scan-cli` is unavailable.
why: Cargo-native installation is the most convenient path for Rust users.
scope: Add a publish workflow using a scoped token, publishing core then cli in lockstep.
guidance: Ensure `readme`, `license`, and repository metadata are correct for docs.rs.
security: Use a least-privilege crates.io token stored as a secret.
deps: Requires release binaries issue for ordering.

title: ci(security): pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs
problem: Actions are referenced by mutable tags, which is a supply-chain risk.
why: Pinning to immutable SHAs prevents a compromised tag from executing in CI.
scope: Replace version tags with commit SHAs plus a comment naming the version; add Dependabot to update them.
guidance: Use `pinact` or manual pinning; keep the version comment.

title: ci(deps): configure automated dependency updates
problem: Dependencies are updated manually and can drift or accumulate advisories.
why: Automated updates keep the supply chain current and surface advisories early.
scope: Add Dependabot configuration for Cargo and GitHub Actions, grouped to reduce noise.

title: ci(release): generate an SBOM and artifact attestation
problem: There is no software bill of materials or provenance for released artifacts.
why: SBOMs and provenance support downstream supply-chain verification.
scope: Generate an SBOM (CycloneDX) and attach it to releases; add build provenance for binaries.
dod: Merged and produced for a release.

title: ci(msrv): pin and test a minimum supported Rust version
problem: The compatibility docs state that no MSRV is guaranteed; users on older toolchains get no clear signal.
why: A tested MSRV is a concrete compatibility promise.
scope: Choose an MSRV, declare `rust-version`, add a CI job for it, and update compatibility docs.
guidance: Verify the lockfile format and all dependencies build on that toolchain.
